contexts_inputs_relation.explanation: Builder serializes the same closed Top-3 context objects twice; no prompt-templating transformation occurs before future generation.

decision.reason: Reproducible selection, direct quotas, consistent full ranks and Top-3 projection, invariant Top-3, no payload label leakage, intact freeze, and no LLM execution. Phase I remains unstarted pending review.

evaluation_only_audit.interpretation: reference_rank_evaluation_only is rank within exported Phase A Top-3, zero if reference code is absent there; it is not complete Phase A exact_rank. Its 20 zeroes are ten full ranks 4-10 and ten full ranks 11-50.
evaluation_only_audit.previous_report_correction: Previous Top-1=0/50 and Top-3=50/50 came from reading nonexistent column reference_rank instead of reference_rank_evaluation_only. No frozen artifact is affected.

label_leakage.interpretation: Expected label supports sample design only. Future LLM payloads contain no expected/reference fields or values.

potential_bug_audit.result: No material selection bug found. Only the earlier external report used a nonexistent column.

scope: Read-only microaudit of frozen HE4. No reselection, retrieval, LLM call, response generation, or Phase I execution.

bucket_conditions_in_code_order.difficult_low_support: exact_rank == 0 OR exact_rank > 10 OR support bucket in 0, 1, 2-4, 5-9; after prior branches on this non-negative population, equals exact_rank == 0 OR exact_rank > 10.

selector.bucket_semantics: Ordered conditions make buckets mutually exclusive and exhaustive. difficult_low_support is not an independent low-support stratum for ranks 1-10; support determines selection order. All selected difficult cases have support_count_dams 1-3.
selector.deduplication_and_priority: used case_id prevents reuse; targets are processed rank_1, rank_2_3, rank_4_10, difficult_low_support.
selector.exact_rank_definition: One-based rank of expected NANDINA in Phase A complete code-deduplicated candidate list; zero means absent.
selector.fallback: Target rows in global order, followed by non-target rows in global order, skipping used case_id. No fallback selected.
selector.input_population: historical_case_summary.csv: 1056 frozen Phase A evaluation rows.
selector.seed_2026: Metadata only; no random generator or shuffle is called.
selector.selection_order: Support bucket 0, 1, 2-4, 5-9, 10+; numeric support ascending; exact rank ascending with zero last; case_id ascending.
selector.support_count_dams_definition: Count of distinct historical DAM declarations supporting expected NANDINA in the frozen historical split.
